filled: function filled(x){if(x==null||x==='')return false;if(Array.isArray(x))return x.some(filled);if(typeof x==='object')return Object.keys(x).some(k=>filled(x[k]));return true}

function qrSvg(pl){try{const q=qrcode(0,'L');q.addData(unescape(encodeURIComponent(pl)),'Byte');q.make();return q.createSvgTag({cellSize:4,margin:4,scalable:true})}catch(e){return '

QR trop long : utilise « Copier le texte ».

anim:
function animQr(title,sub,parts){let i=0;modal(`

${title}

${sub}

${qrSvg(parts[0])}

${parts.length>1?'1 / '+parts.length+' · laisse le prof viser jusqu’au bip final':''}

`); if(RQ.h)clearInterval(RQ.h);if(parts.length>1)RQ.h=setInterval(()=>{i=(i+1)%parts.length;const q=$('#rqr'),n=$('#rqn');if(!q){clearInterval(RQ.h);return}q.innerHTML=qrSvg(parts[i]);n.textContent=(i+1)+' / '+parts.length+' · laisse le prof viser jusqu’au bip final'},1200)}
chunk:
function chunkPayload(str,size){const tag=Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,6);const n=Math.ceil(str.length/size);const out=[];
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++)out.push('DFP|'+tag+'|'+(i+1)+'/'+n+'|'+str.slice(i*size,(i+1)*size));return out}
